digest.component_or_area: pytest test infrastructure / temporary directory management
propositions: Nested pytest processes without explicit parent-owned --basetemp allocate shared user-global numbered temp roots and delete cleanup-eligible trees from unrelated runs at session finish

test_engine_submodules_resolve_when_the_tests_unit_shadow_is_active and test_repro_module_passes_standalone each launch executing child pytest without --basetemp, causing their children to register cleanup in the shared numbered root

pytest 9.1.1 TempPathFactory.getbasetemp creates and registers numbered-root cleanup; pytest_sessionfinish skips cleanup only while _basetemp remains None, allowing unowned children to delete sibling temp trees

Repair assigns each executing nested child a private --basetemp under the parent tmp_path fixture (tmp_path/mixed-module-pytest and tmp_path/standalone-pytest respectively) and asserts materialization

Held-out regression oracle seeded an isolated shared numbered root with cleanup-eligible sentinel; before repair both affected cases deleted the sentinel; after repair all cases preserved exact sentinel bytes and shared-root entries
